subject: general
question: 48 men can do a work in 5 days while 40 women can do the same work in 9 days. In how many days can 4 men and 6 women together do the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

48 men can do a work in 5 days

40 women can do the same work in 9 days

**Formula used:**

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = (1)/(48 times 5)

Work done by 1 woman in 1 day = (1)/(40 times 9)

**Calculation:**

Work done by 1 man in 1 day = (1)/(240)
